board.startBody: Name the board and yourself. Your family joins with an invite link — no accounts, no passwords.
board.createFailed: Could not create the board. Try again.
board.joinBody: Paste the invite link you were sent, and give your name. On a new phone, paste your recovery link: your name stays as it was.
board.joinRejected: That invite does not work. It may have been withdrawn, or the link is incomplete.
board.shareBody: Send this link privately. Anyone who opens it joins as a Member until you remove them.
board.dropHint: Drag a Meal anywhere, or tap it to plan it.
board.yourNameHint: Shown on meals you add — "Dad wants this".
board.keyWarning: This phone holds your key to the board. Save your recovery link in Settings, or you lose the board along with your last device.
board.inviteUnreadable: No invite link in there. Check you copied the whole thing.
board.dropHintTouch: Hold a Meal to carry it, or tap it to plan it.
board.leftoverOrder: Leftovers come after the Meal they are from. Move the Meal first.
board.joinOffline: Could not reach the relay. Check your connection and try again.
board.shareFailed: Could not make an invite. Only admins can, and you need to be online.
board.writeFailed: Could not save that change. Try again.
board.relayFull: This board is full. Changes stay on this phone but cannot reach the others.
board.relayBusy: The sync service is busy. Changes will be sent shortly.
board.replaceTitle: Replace the board that is open?
board.replaceBody: This phone holds one board at a time. The one open now is replaced, and it cannot be opened here again without its recovery link.
board.joinNotSaved: You joined, but this phone could not save the board. Try again.
board.createNotSaved: The board was made, but this phone could not save it. Try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.slotsBody: Slots are the rows on every day of the board. They are the same for everyone in the household.
settings.removeKeepsMeals: Removing a slot keeps what was planned in it — put the slot back and the meals reappear.
settings.slotsFull: That is as many slots as a day column can hold.

error.duplicate-slot: That slot is already on the board.
error.too-many-slots: That is as many slots as a day column can hold.
error.last-slot: A board needs at least one slot.
error.name-required: Give the slot a name first.
error.writeFailed: Could not save the slots. Try again.

settings.appearanceHint: The board is light unless you say otherwise. This is remembered on this device.
settings.sizeHint: New meals start at this many servings. Meals you already have keep theirs.
settings.languageHint: The whole board speaks it — the catalogue and the shopping list too, for everyone in the household.
settings.membersBody: Admins can invite, remove and promote. Removing someone cuts them off from everything written afterwards.
settings.removeBody: They lose access from now on. What they have already synced stays on their phone.
settings.recoveryBody: Keep this link in your password manager. On a new or replacement phone, open it or paste it on the join screen and you carry on as yourself. Anyone who has it can use the board as you until an admin removes you.
